Title: 1 in 2 women over 50 will break a bone from this - here's why

Description:
About 1 in 2 women over 50 will break a bone from osteoporosis, and most never see it coming. Three everyday drinks quietly speed up bone loss - soda, coffee, and alcohol - and each one has a simple swap.

Watch to find out why they weaken your bones, and what to do instead so you don't have to give them up completely.
